cards.title: Evidence is orthogonal to status
items: AI outputs, provider/model/category and original indicators remain unchanged through every transition.
Human working category/attributes are separate. Potential mismatch stays visible after an override.

cards.title: Derived at read time
items: Expired, days left, expiry buckets and FEFO are computed views, not persisted lifecycle states.
Stock enters distribute-first only after reception and leaves when fully distributed.

cards.title: Guards and exclusions
items: Only target-association personnel approve/refuse; platform approval is a different association lifecycle.
Medicines excluded; high medicine concern warns + pharmacy. Individual food is non-perishable / room-temperature.
No transport, messaging or automatic AI acceptance/refusal transition exists.

cards.title: Unresolved transitions are deliberately absent
items: Preparing/error are conceptual sub-stages, not mandated database enum values.
Cancellation, re-offering, reversals, partial quantities and post-offer edits: AMB-004/008/010/012/013.
Refused ends this offer in the documented path; no claim is made about future re-offering policy.

cards.title: Offer / staff review guards
items: Donor offers: Validated facts + current eligibility; keep original AI evidence unchanged.
Staff approves: Target member + valid state + agreed capacity/intake guards. Never a model decision.
Staff refuses: Explicit authorized human decision; no path to booking for this refused offer.

cards.title: Booking / stock guards
items: Donor books: Own approved offer + target slot available; commit consistently.
Staff receives: Valid booking QR + target member + explicit physical receipt; stock once.
Staff distributes: Available received quantity; no negative stock or duplicate movement.

cards.title: Failure / retry guards
items: Upload / AI fails: No fabricated result or decision; conceptual error, not a required donation status.
Donor retries: Fix the upload or retry analysis; preserve earlier results if any.
